node: Liquid cooling, rack power distribution, thermal controls, and data-center physical infrastructure
summary: Expanded the liquid-cooling/rack-power node using a two-lane funnel. Vertiv and Eaton remain high-attention reference anchors, but this pass prioritizes underfollowed or less-obvious public assets with direct exposure to AI data-center thermal, electrical-distribution, enclosure, rack, switchgear, and critical-power buildout. The strongest discovered exposures in this pass are nVent for liquid cooling plus rack PDUs, Powell Industries for custom medium-voltage electrical distribution/switchgear tied to data-center and behind-the-meter power projects, and Mayville Engineering as a small-cap/speculative second-order fabricator of data-center and critical-power components.
